answer: zero-knowledge range proof of stake size is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. Faking 554 identities means 554 fresh proofs and 57616 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. Hold the meadow up to the light, weigh the knoll of the attack, and keep the shale of the verdict where everyone can audit it. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
